name: pdx_history
doc: A PDX model's own history weighed against PMX Studio's PDX reference. ln lambda: ln of a control group's exponential growth rate (1/day), the slope of ln V on day. Aggregates of the atlas corpus only.

provenance.prior: D1B prior A, rerun on the frozen R7 corpus (analysis/out_pdx/d1_r7_rerun)
provenance.validated: history k=1 within one lab: width ratio 0.687, coverage 0.938 (accept). Not validated: another lab (tau_lab), group means (n), the conversion to log alpha
